name: askdock-mobile-tall-crush
description: ask dock on a phone, as the transcript's trailing row: inline bold option labels (no chip pills) never overlap their detail text and wrap inside the card however long or unbroken they are; the dock sizes to its content with no internal scroll; the tall batch extends the transcript's own scroll region without changing any pane allocation

mutation.declaration: askquestioncard.module.css: .option { overflow-wrap: break-word } - reverting it lets the harness's unbroken-token label escape the card horizontally (assertion B)
mutation.note: The previous mutation target (askdock.module.css's .dock containment pair) was removed with the footer-anchored design: the dock is the transcript's trailing row now, so containment comes from the transcript scroller, not the dock. The label assertions stay structural to the inline-flow .option layout; the unbroken-token label is what makes this declaration's removal observable.
